sources.title: Ona Overview
sources.finding: New customer signup closed; existing customers and new members of existing orgs continue. Interactive sessions and automated fleets on own AWS/GCP VPC are documented.

sources.title: Ona Codex Agent
sources.finding: Codex harness in Ona environment on AWS/GCP; Core+ with org enablement and runner OpenAI-compatible integration. Enterprise BYOK. Model/effort/Fast/Goal mode subject to org controls.

sources.title: Ona Automations
sources.finding: Prompts/commands/PR/report steps run in isolated dev environments. Manual/schedule/PR/webhook triggers; laptop need not be on. Core/Enterprise limits apply.

sources.title: Ona Automation configuration
sources.finding: Sequential prompt/command/PR/report steps in one environment. Service accounts for scheduled work with permission checks. Disable preserves config/history but prevents new runs.

sources.title: Ona Automation limits
sources.finding: Core 50 automations/10 parallel/50 total actions; Enterprise unlimited definitions/25 parallel/1000 total system ceiling. Webhook sources Enterprise; Core GitHub PR triggers available.

sources.title: Ona Runner architecture
sources.finding: Ona-hosted management plane coordinates; user VPC runners execute code and hold SCM credentials. AWS EC2/GCP Compute VMs provide environments; infrastructure managed by customer.

sources.title: Ona Persistent storage
sources.finding: VM disk persists stop/start. Repository bind mount preserves uncommitted code on rebuild; other filesystem recreated unless mounted. Prebuilds snapshot environment.

sources.title: Ona Archive and deletion
sources.finding: Core archives after 3 inactive days then deletes after 4 more; Enterprise timings configurable including never-delete. Deleted content permanently removed.

sources.title: Ona CLI
sources.finding: Product-owned ona CLI with macOS/Linux/Windows downloads manages environments (create/start/stop/delete), SSH, ports, prebuilds, webhooks and environment tasks/services; browser login and personal access token authentication documented.

sources.title: Ona SDK
sources.finding: Python/TypeScript/Go SDK creates environments, runs commands and launches Codex.

sources.title: Ona Agent skills
sources.finding: Reusable SKILL.md instructions guide agent workflows; project/repository and organization skill context.

sources.title: Ona MCP integrations
sources.finding: Configured external MCP tools extend agents; config in repository or organization integrations with OAuth/secrets.

sources.title: Ona Organization roles
sources.finding: Enterprise scoped admin roles plus Insights/Audit/Billing viewers; group assignment and immediate role revocation.

sources.title: Ona SSO
sources.finding: Enterprise OIDC SSO supports multiple IdPs/domains; org admins configure and verify domains. Deactivation does not invalidate existing login sessions.

sources.title: Ona Guardrails
sources.finding: Identity, org policy, runtime command/executable restrictions and audit logs; kernel Veto described separately from broad deny-list controls.

sources.title: Ona Cost and budgets
sources.finding: Core OCU balance/daily usage chart; standard 4vCPU/16GB 1 OCU/hour and GPU 7 OCUs/hour. Enterprise uses separate credits/BYOK usage API; no current USD starting price.

sources.title: Ona SCM tools
sources.finding: GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket PR create/read/update/merge/comment and CI status. Cannot approve/request changes or sync PR base branch; group controls can disable tools.

sources.title: Ona Dev Containers
sources.finding: devcontainer.json defines version-controlled dependencies, Docker Compose services, mounts and tools; Dev Container image cache and Tasks and Services are documented.

sources.title: Ona changelog
sources.finding: Mac Desktop security release requires macOS13+. Review file tree/inline diffs/comments and Plan mode spec.md documented as shipped. August31 model-access fix prevents inherited access token overriding configured access.

sources.title: Ona current procurement
sources.finding: /pricing redirects to contact/sales; no current public recurring USD price.

sources.title: Ona service terms
sources.finding: Company service access is licensed under commercial terms; service source-reversal/copying restrictions distinct from third-party open-source components.

sources.title: Ona joining OpenAI
sources.finding: Ona states transaction officially closed August 10, 2026 and company is part of OpenAI.

sources.title: Ona Cloud is shutting down on October 31, 2026
sources.locator: October 13 announcement; Can I keep using Ona Cloud; How do I save my work; refunds; automatic migration FAQ
sources.finding: Ona announces Cloud wind-down on October 31, 2026; existing Cloud access only until that date and new signup already closed. Customers must back up code/files; October payments and unused purchased credits refunded. Environments do not migrate automatically to Codex. Enterprise or self-hosted offerings are not stated to end.
